CREATE TABLE lex_exercise ( id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, set_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, node_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, language_id VARCHAR(8) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci NOT NULL, level VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, exam VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, exam_part VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, item_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, position INT NOT NULL, skill_tag VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, difficulty TINYINT NOT NULL, instruction TEXT NOT NULL, stem TEXT COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, options JSON NOT NULL, answer_index TINYINT NOT NULL, explanation_vi TEXT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, needs_review TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version INT NOT NULL, doc JSON NOT NULL, content_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY ix_lex_exercise_set (set_id, position), KEY ix_lex_exercise_node (node_id, item_type, difficulty), CONSTRAINT fk_lex_exercise_node FOREIGN KEY (node_id) REFERENCES lex_node (node_id), CONSTRAINT fk_lex_exercise_language FOREIGN KEY (language_id) REFERENCES language (id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_ci;
CREATE TABLE lex_exercise_entry ( exercise_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, entry_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (exercise_id, entry_id), KEY ix_lex_exercise_entry_entry (entry_id), CONSTRAINT fk_lex_exercise_entry_exercise FOREIGN KEY (exercise_id) REFERENCES lex_exercise (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_lex_exercise_entry_entry FOREIGN KEY (entry_id) REFERENCES lex_entry (id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_ci;
